title: 2.6 Numbers 1-5
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Count from one to five, name a number with Es el número…, and count things in the plural.
grammar_function: Es el número + number; number + plural noun.
speaking_outcome: Say the numbers one to five and count things.
